text: AKKI PLATFORM  ·  ENGINE SPECIFICATION  ·  CONTEXT MANAGEMENT LAYER
Data Cleanliness
data_cleanliness_v1 — which records check out, which do not, and what may enter training

rows: Garbage in produces garbage out at an unknown rate. Shape — how many tables, which columns are empty, where personal data sits — is not cleanliness. Nothing on the platform yet answers, per record: is this structurally valid, does it agree with itself, does it agree with the other copy, and can it be relied on for a purpose. Marking a record unmeasured is honest; it is not the same as keeping it out.

The census quality profile (Document 9 B3): null rates, constant columns, cardinality, orphan tables, foreign-key candidates, personal-data signals, drift between runs. Deterministic; every figure carries its method. Structured sources only.

Seven check families producing a per-record bitmap; four strata rolled up from it; a garbage register per source; a deterministic gate that decides what may enter a training manifest; and the build decomposition under the Execution Standard.
Clean is not a property of a dataset. It is a set of verdicts per field, per record, against named checks. A number without its checks is not a measure.

text: 1   Definitions
Check  a named, deterministic predicate over one record, or over one record and another it is compared with, returning pass, fail, or not applicable.
Rule pack  the set of checks that apply to one source, confirmed by the data owner. A check enters a pack only on confirmation.
Bitmap  the per-record vector of check outcomes. Every bit maps to a named check in the pack.
Sentinel  a value that passes type checks and carries no information: a placeholder date, a dummy identifier, a required-field filler.
Natural key  the field or fields that identify the same real-world entity across sources: a phone number, a national identifier, an account number — hashed where personal.
Stratum  one of Clean, Repairable, Suspect, Junk, assigned to a record from its bitmap by fixed rule.
Garbage register  the per-source report: share of each stratum, the list of records per stratum, and the failing checks that placed each.
Repair  a deterministic transformation with a stated inverse or a retained original: trim, normalise a format, parse a date, map an enumeration. Never a guess at a value.
2   The Check Families
Seven families, run in this order because each depends on the last. Each is a subtask under the Execution Standard with its own denominator, artefact, and acceptance.
2.1  Structural validity

DQ-1  Every field parses to its declared type; every formatted field matches its format rule; encodings are valid — a field containing mojibake fails; every foreign key resolves to an existing row. The census foreign-key candidate graph is the input; the check is whether each candidate resolves.  [family 1]
2.2  Sentinels

DQ-2  Every source carries a sentinel list, built from cardinality: a value appearing in a supposedly unique or high-cardinality field at a share above a ruled threshold (R-38) is a sentinel candidate; a candidate becomes a sentinel on the owner's confirmation. A record carrying a sentinel in a field fails that field's check. Sentinels are never silently nulled.  [family 2]
2.3  Internal consistency

DQ-3  Cross-field rules a record must satisfy: ordered dates; totals equal to their parts; enumerations within their set; values inside the window another field defines. Rules come from the owner interview per source; a learned component may propose candidates from profiling, and a candidate is a rule only on confirmation.  [family 3]
2.4  Duplication

DQ-4  Three grades, each producing a match list with tier and evidence: exact, by row hash; key-based, the same natural key on more than one row; fuzzy, normalised fields within a ruled tolerance (R-39). No grade merges. A merge is a human act recorded with the records it joined and the rule it applied.  [family 4]
2.5  Cross-source agreement

DQ-5  Every entity with a natural key in two or more sources is matched and compared field by field where fields are shared. The output is a disagreement list and a disagreement rate per field per source pair. The check records which source disagrees; it does not decide which is right.  [family 5]
2.6  Plausibility and drift

DQ-6  Values outside a physically or logically possible range fail; values beyond a ruled distance from the field's own distribution are flagged, not failed; distribution shift between census runs beyond what growth explains is flagged at the field. Flags are recorded in the bitmap as their own bit.  [family 6]
2.7  Provenance

DQ-7  Every record carries its source, its writing pipeline where known, and its write time where known. A record with none of the three is not failed; it is marked provenance-unknown, which caps its stratum at Suspect for any purpose requiring defensibility.  [family 7]
2.8  Media objects

DQ-8  For audio and video objects, the structural family includes: decodability; header duration against payload duration; sample rate against the channel's declared rate; clipping and silence ratio against ruled thresholds (R-40); duplicate detection by acoustic fingerprint as the fuzzy grade of DQ-4. None of these uses a learned model.  [families 1, 4, 6 for media]
3   Strata

rows: Every applicable check in the pack passes; no plausibility flag; provenance known
Enters any use its custody class permits
Fails only checks with a defined repair (DQ-9); nothing else
Enters use after repair; original retained; repair recorded
Fails a consistency, cross-source or plausibility check; or provenance unknown; or a fuzzy-duplicate match
Enters use only on an owner decision per rule, recorded
Fails structural validity; carries a sentinel in a required field; or is an exact or key duplicate of a retained row
Never enters training; never enters an answer as fact; listed, not deleted

text: DQ-9  A repair is deterministic, named in the pack, and either reversible or applied with the original retained alongside. A repair that requires choosing between values is not a repair; it is a Suspect outcome for a human.

DQ-10  Stratum assignment is a pure function of the bitmap and the pack. Two runs over the same record with the same pack version assign the same stratum. The pack is versioned; a pack change re-strata the source and the change is receipted.
4   The Garbage Register

DQ-11  Every source has a garbage register per pack version: the count and share of each stratum; the list of records per stratum with the checks that placed each; the sentinel list; the duplicate lists by grade; the disagreement list; the repairs applied. It is the artefact of this specification, and every figure on any surface derives from it.
DQ-12  The register reconciles: Clean + Repairable + Suspect + Junk = the source's record count, exactly, per pack version. A register that does not reconcile is not published.

DQ-13  Accuracy — whether a value is true — is measured only where ground truth exists and is named. Where it does not, the register states accuracy: not measured. Validity, consistency, uniqueness, plausibility and provenance are never presented as accuracy.
5   The Training Gate

DQ-14  A training manifest cites only records in Clean or Repairable strata. A Suspect record enters a manifest only with an owner decision receipt naming the rule it failed and the reason it is admitted. A Junk record in a manifest is refused at commission. This is one MOAC criterion: every cited unit carries a passing bitmap at the pack version named in the manifest.  [Targeta; MOAC]
DQ-15  The same gate applies to any unit cited as fact in an answer: a Junk record is never the anchor of a fact-class claim; a Suspect record anchors at most an inference.  [Doc 4 A2; A5.5]
6   Build Decomposition — under the Execution Standard
Each row is a subtask carrying the six fields of the task contract. Denominators are pinned before procedures run; acceptance scripts are written first; reconciliation is the first check in each.

text: Shortcut list for this specification (EX-5)

Running checks on a sample of tables and reporting the estate. Declaring sentinels from the heuristic without owner confirmation. A strata total that does not reconcile to the record count. “No duplicates found” with no fingerprint index or hash table on record. A training manifest citing records with no bitmap at the named pack version. Each has a detector in the acceptance script of the subtask it belongs to.
Build order

Subtasks 1, 2, 3 and the exact grade of 6 first — days of work over the existing profile, and they find most of the junk. Subtasks 4 and 3 need one owner interview per source. Subtask 7 is the one piece of real engineering. Subtask 8 waits on the media enumeration tools. Subtask 10 is one criterion added to MOAC.
7   Placement in the Standing Enumerations

rows: IN: the check runner (DQ-1 to DQ-8), stratum assignment (DQ-10), and the training gate (DQ-14) — deterministic; their failure falsifies S-34. OUT: any component that proposes candidate rules or sentinels from profiling — learned or heuristic; it proposes, the owner confirms.
Data cleanliness: Deterministic in all decision paths; Hybrid only in rule-candidate proposal.
Pack unreadable → no strata published, source marked not-assessed. Check runner cannot reach a record → unmeasured with reason, never Clean by default. Register does not reconcile → not published.
The bitmap and register are census artefacts: per stratum, method-carried, objective-blind. The pack is confirmed by the owner, not shaped by any job.
DQ-1 through DQ-15 and S-34 at this refresh.

text: 8   New Promise

rows: The platform knows, per record, which checks it passed and which it failed; no figure about cleanliness is shown without its checks; nothing that failed structural validity or carries a sentinel enters training or anchors a fact; and every source’s strata reconcile to its record count.
DQ-1 to DQ-15. Bounds: R-38 to R-40. Scope edge: accuracy is measured only where ground truth exists and is named.

text: 9   What This Does Not Claim
LIM-1  It does not measure truth. Validity, consistency, uniqueness, plausibility and provenance are what it measures; accuracy only against named ground truth.
LIM-2  It does not write rule packs. Rules come from owners; the platform proposes candidates and runs what is confirmed.
LIM-3  It does not delete. Junk is listed and kept out; removal is an owner act under the retention and erasure rules.
LIM-4  It does not use a learned model to decide a stratum. Any future learned quality signal enters as a plausibility flag through the research queue and never as a bit that fails a record.
10   Rulings
R-38  Sentinel candidate threshold: share of a field above which a single value is a candidate. Recommend 2% in fields with a role signal of identifier or timestamp; 20% elsewhere. DEFAULT-class.
R-39  Fuzzy-duplicate tolerance per field type (normalised string distance; numeric tolerance). Recommend baseline-period approach from the first run’s match lists. DEFAULT-class.
R-40  Media thresholds: silence ratio, clipping share, header-payload duration tolerance. Recommend from the first enumerated channel’s distribution. DEFAULT-class.

Design note. The cheapest checks find the most junk: sentinels, format validity, exact duplicates. The most expensive check — cross-source agreement — finds the junk nobody knew was junk, because both copies looked fine on their own. Build in that order, and publish the register after the first three; a partial register that reconciles is worth more than a complete one that does not exist.
